summary: Frontend-only test of the new Oggi doctor screen inside the standard AppShell. Tested at the real clock (22:06, all visits past, empty next-bar) and with the Playwright clock mocked to 10:05 (populated next-bar). Almost all requested items pass: shell/sidebar, date and greeting (Buongiorno at 10:05, Buonasera at 22:06), Tutti/Centro/Provincia filter hiding the other group, dark 52px next-bar, Cartella button opening the passport (Francesco Bruno), Inizia visita opening the real ConsultationOverlay (consent 'Consenso privacy valido' shown when a patient is set, free-name setup when none), clicking a row updates the detail panel (aria-pressed), allergies shown for Aurora Ricci (Amoxicillina) and Ginevra Marino (Acari della polvere), ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End move focus and selection across groups, Apri cartella opens the passport, exactly one now-line placed right before the first future visit (or after the last group when all visits are past), legend shown, Note da firmare opens a note with note-sign-btn, Messaggi navigates to /app/messaggi, no waiting room. Responsive: no horizontal overflow at 390/768/1440, panels stack at 390 and sit side by side at 768+, the mobile bottom tab bar does not cover the legend. Regression: pazienti, messaggi, cassa, impostazioni, strumenti all render (data-section correct). The oggi-todo-requests item could NOT be tested because there are 0 pending portal requests in the DB (not seeded by me).

ui_bugs.issue: When the filtered list contains only future visits (e.g. Provincia at 10:05, first visit 15:00), nowBefore is null, so no 'Ora HH:MM' line shows at all. Expected the line to show at the top, before the first visit.

issues: The next-bar wraps to 76px and the patient name gets truncated ('Francesco Brun…'); age and reason are hidden. Consider putting the name on its own line on mobile.
Past visits that are not completed (e.g. 10:15–17:15 at 22:06) still show the 'In programma' amber dot. Consider a 'missed/da chiudere' state, or confirm this is intended.

action_items: Optional: show the now-line before the first item when every visible visit is in the future (OggiScreen.jsx nowBefore logic).
Optional: improve the mobile next-bar layout so the patient name isn't truncated.
Verify oggi-todo-requests by hand once a pending portal request exists (none in the DB during this test).
critical_code_review_comments: OggiScreen: `next` is computed from all clinics while the detail fallback uses the filtered list. With Provincia selected, the next-bar shows a Centro patient and the detail shows Alice Conti. This is acceptable, but the behaviour should be a conscious choice.
OggiScreen: the `today` filter keeps appointments with date==null as today. That's fine if the API always sends a date.
Files are small and clean (<75 lines each); data-testids are complete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use page.clock.install(time=datetime(2026,11,3,10,5)) before login to get a populated next-bar (seed visits 08:30–17:15; at 10:05 the next visit is Francesco Bruno, 10:15). Visit ids look like oggi-visit-6ad86e64c06e50ff4cd67d53..5c. There are 0 pending portal requests, so oggi-todo-requests is hidden.
